title: Shamrocks
selectSource: Pick the top card of a fan to move
selectDestination: Pick a destination (a fan or a foundation)

tutorial.foundation: The 4 foundations. Build each suit up from the Ace to the King; clear all 52 cards to win.
tutorial.fan: Only the top card of each fan can move. Stack it onto a fan whose top is the next-higher card of the same suit.
tutorial.actionButtons: Hint shows a suggested move. Auto-complete moves cards to foundations when possible, and undo takes back your last move.

frontendHint.shamrocksToFoundation: This fan's card can go to a foundation
frontendHint.shamrocksToFan: This fan's card can move to another fan
